title: Vashishta urges Rama to grant the prayer of Bharata
introduction: Vashishta urges Rama to grant the prayer of Bharata. Rama replies that the command given by his father cannot be disregarded. Bharata then decides to undertake a fest unto death as a last resort to exert pressure on Rama. On Rama's dubbing such a step as repugnant to the code of conduct prescribed for a kshatriya, Bharata requests Rama to allow him to remain in the forest as the latter's proxy. Rama, however, rules out this proposition also, saying that it is a matter of reproach. He reaffirms his resolve to enter Ayodhya only after implementing the pledge given to his father.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 111th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठः तु तदा रामम् उक्त्वा राज पुरोहितः |
अब्रवीद् धर्म सम्युक्तम् पुनर् एव अपरम् वचः
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭhaḥ tu tadā rāmam uktvā rāja purohitaḥ |
abravīd dharma samyuktam punar eva aparam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Having spoken thus to Rama, Vasishta the royal priest added the following righteous words:

verses.devanagari:
पुरुषस्य इह जातस्य भवन्ति गुरवः त्रयः |
आचार्यः चैव काकुत्स्थ पिता माता च राघव
verses.iast:
puruṣasya iha jātasya bhavanti guravaḥ trayaḥ |
ācāryaḥ caiva kākutstha pitā mātā ca rāghava
verses.translation: "O, Kakutstha, O offspring the Raghu dynasty! From birth, the three spiritual instructors of a man are his teacher, his father and his mother."

verses.devanagari:
पिता ह्य् एनम् जनयति पुरुषम् पुरुष ऋषभ |
प्रज्नाम् ददाति च आचार्यः तस्मात् स गुरुर् उच्यते
verses.iast:
pitā hy enam janayati puruṣam puruṣa ṛṣabha |
prajnām dadāti ca ācāryaḥ tasmāt sa gurur ucyate
verses.translation: "O, excellent among men! The father of man his life. The teacher instructs him in wisdom and therefore instructs the teacher is said to be the superior!"

verses.devanagari:
से ते अहम् पितुर् आचार्यः तव चैव परम् तप |
मम त्वम् वचनम् कुर्वन् न अतिवर्तेः सताम् गतिम्
verses.iast:
se te aham pitur ācāryaḥ tava caiva param tapa |
mama tvam vacanam kurvan na ativarteḥ satām gatim
verses.translation: "O, Rama the tormentator of the enemies! I am the spiritual Preceptor to your father and to you too. In obeying my words, you will not transgress the path of the virtuous."

verses.devanagari:
इमा हि ते परिषदः श्रेणयः च समागताः |
एषु तात चरन् धर्मम् न अतिवर्तेः सताम् गतिम्
verses.iast:
imā hi te pariṣadaḥ śreṇayaḥ ca samāgatāḥ |
eṣu tāta caran dharmam na ativarteḥ satām gatim
verses.translation: "O, dear prince! These subjects, the traders, the other categories of people and Brahmana are your people only. In fulfilling your duty to them, you will not be transgressing your righteous path."

glosses.meaning: the traders and other categories of people

verses.devanagari:
वृद्धाया धर्म शीलाया मातुर् न अर्हस्य् अवर्तितुम् |
अस्याः तु वचनम् कुर्वन् न अतिवर्तेः सताम् गतिम्
verses.iast:
vṛddhāyā dharma śīlāyā mātur na arhasy avartitum |
asyāḥ tu vacanam kurvan na ativarteḥ satām gatim
verses.translation: "You ought not to be lacking in reverence to your mother who is aged and possessing a noble conduct. By carrying out her words, you will not deviate from the path of the virtuous."

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य वचः कुर्वन् याचमानस्य राघव |
आत्मानम् न अतिवर्तेः त्वम् सत्य धर्म पराक्रम
verses.iast:
bharatasya vacaḥ kurvan yācamānasya rāghava |
ātmānam na ativarteḥ tvam satya dharma parākrama
verses.translation: "O, Rama excelling in truth and virtue. By fulfilling the words of the beseeching Bharata, you will not be false to yourself."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् मधुरम् उक्तः तु गुरुणा राघवः स्वयम् |
प्रत्युवाच समासीनम् वसिष्ठम् पुरुष ऋषभः
verses.iast:
evam madhuram uktaḥ tu guruṇā rāghavaḥ svayam |
pratyuvāca samāsīnam vasiṣṭham puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ
verses.translation: Having heard the sweet words spoken by his spiritual preceptro himself, Rama the excellent among men replied (as follows) to Vasishta who was seated there.

verses.devanagari:
यन् मातापितरौ वृत्तम् तनये कुरुतः सदा |
न सुप्रतिकरम् तत् तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत् कृतम्
यथा शक्ति प्रदानेन स्नापनाच् चादनेन च |
नित्यम् च प्रिय वादेन तथा सम्वर्धनेन च
verses.iast:
yan mātāpitarau vṛttam tanaye kurutaḥ sadā |
na supratikaram tat tu mātrā pitrā ca yat kṛtam
yathā śakti pradānena snāpanāc cādanena ca |
nityam ca priya vādena tathā samvardhanena ca
verses.translation: "The good, which a father and mother do, by giving whatever they can, to their son constantly, by putting him to sleep, rubbing his body with oil etc, nay, by speaking kindly to him every moment, and even by nourishing him, can never be wholly requited."

glosses.meaning: by giving him whatever they can

verses.devanagari:
स हि राजा जनयिता पिता दशरथो मम |
आज्नातम् यन् मया तस्य न तन् मिथ्या भविष्यति
verses.iast:
sa hi rājā janayitā pitā daśaratho mama |
ājnātam yan mayā tasya na tan mithyā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "The command laid upon me by king Dasaratha, my father, who begot me, cannot therefore be disregarded."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण भरतः प्रत्यनन्तरम् |
उवाच परम उदारः सूतम् परम दुर्मनाः
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa bharataḥ pratyanantaram |
uvāca parama udāraḥ sūtam parama durmanāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing Rama's words, the most generous Bharata felt very mcuh anguished and addressed the following words to Sumantra the charioteer who was standing nearby:

verses.devanagari:
इह मे स्थण्डिले शीघ्रम् कुशान् आस्तर सारथे |
आर्यम् प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन् मे न प्रसीदति
verses.iast:
iha me sthaṇḍile śīghram kuśān āstara sārathe |
āryam pratyupavekṣyāmi yāvan me na prasīdati
verses.translation: "O, charioteer! Spread speedily the Kusha grass on the ground here for me. I shall remain facing my illustrious brother till he gets propitiated (and grant my request)."

glosses.meaning: he does not get me propitiated.

verses.devanagari:
अनाहारो निरालोको धन हीनो यथा द्विजः |
शेष्ये पुरस्तात् शालाया यावन् न प्रतियास्यति
verses.iast:
anāhāro nirāloko dhana hīno yathā dvijaḥ |
śeṣye purastāt śālāyā yāvan na pratiyāsyati
verses.translation: "I shall remain lying down in front of Rama's hut without food or drink and depriving myself of light until he returns to Ayodhya, like a brahman who is a destitute (lies down at the door of his crditor)."

glosses.meaning: he does not return to Ayodhya
who is destitute (likes down at the door of his creditor).

verses.devanagari:
स तु रामम् अवेक्षन्तम् सुमन्त्रम् प्रेक्ष्य दुर्मनाः |
कुश उत्तरम् उपस्थाप्य भूमाउ एव आस्तरत् स्वयम्
verses.iast:
sa tu rāmam avekṣantam sumantram prekṣya durmanāḥ |
kuśa uttaram upasthāpya bhūmāu eva āstarat svayam
verses.translation: Seeing Sumantra who was gazing at Rama waiting for his command, the low-spirited Bharata, on his own, brought a heap of Kusha grass and spread it on the floor.

verses.devanagari:
तम् उवाच महा तेजा रामो राज ऋषि सत्तमाः |
किम् माम् भरत कुर्वाणम् तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि
verses.iast:
tam uvāca mahā tejā rāmo rāja ṛṣi sattamāḥ |
kim mām bharata kurvāṇam tāta pratyupavekṣyasi
verses.translation: Rama of great splendour and the best among royal sages spoke to Bharata as follows: "O Bharata my dear brother! What wrong have I done that you lie down before me?"

glosses.meaning: and the excellent among royal sages

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मणो ह्य् एक पार्श्वेन नरान् रोद्धुम् इह अर्हति |
न तु मूर्धा अवसिक्तानाम् विधिः प्रत्युपवेशने
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇo hy eka pārśvena narān roddhum iha arhati |
na tu mūrdhā avasiktānām vidhiḥ pratyupaveśane
verses.translation: "A brahmana may lie down on one side in order to obstruct a willful debtor in this world. But, it is not befitting for a warrior-class.

verses.devanagari:
उत्तिष्ठ नर शार्दूल हित्वा एतद् दारुणम् व्रतम् |
पुर वर्याम् इतः क्षिप्रम् अयोध्याम् याहि राघव
verses.iast:
uttiṣṭha nara śārdūla hitvā etad dāruṇam vratam |
pura varyām itaḥ kṣipram ayodhyām yāhi rāghava
verses.translation: "O Bharata, Tiger among men! Giving up this formidable resolve, rise up proceed speedily to Ayodhya the best of cities, from here."

verses.devanagari:
आसीनः तु एव भरतः पौर जानपदम् जनम् |
उवाच सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य किम् आर्यम् न अनुशासथ
verses.iast:
āsīnaḥ tu eva bharataḥ paura jānapadam janam |
uvāca sarvataḥ prekṣya kim āryam na anuśāsatha
verses.translation: Still sitting in the same posture, Bharata looked at the citizens and rural folk around on all sides and asked them why they were not entreating his venerable brother to return.

glosses.meaning: the citizens and the rural folk

verses.devanagari:
ते तम् ऊचुर् महात्मानम् पौर जानपदा जनाः |
काकुत्स्थम् अभिजानीमः सम्यग् वदति राघवः
verses.iast:
te tam ūcur mahātmānam paura jānapadā janāḥ |
kākutstham abhijānīmaḥ samyag vadati rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Those people, the inhabitants of town and country replied to the magnanimous Bharata as follows: "We know Rama very well. He is speaking rightly."

glosses.meaning: the inhabitants of town and country

verses.devanagari:
एषो अपि हि महा भागः पितुर् वचसि तिष्ठति |
अत एव न शक्ताः स्मो व्यावर्तयितुम् अन्जसा
verses.iast:
eṣo api hi mahā bhāgaḥ pitur vacasi tiṣṭhati |
ata eva na śaktāḥ smo vyāvartayitum anjasā
verses.translation: "This Rama of exalted merit is indeed standing on his father's words. Hence, we are not able to convince him to return to Ayodhya."

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् आज्नाय वचनम् रामो वचनम् अब्रवीत् |
एवम् निबोध वचनम् सुहृदाम् धर्म चक्षुषाम्
verses.iast:
teṣām ājnāya vacanam rāmo vacanam abravīt |
evam nibodha vacanam suhṛdām dharma cakṣuṣām
verses.translation: Hearing their words, Rama said to Bharata: "Reflect on the words of your companions, who see rightly."

verses.devanagari:
एतच् च एव उभयम् श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सम्पश्य राघव |
उत्तिष्ठ त्वम् महा बाहो माम् च स्पृश तथा उदकम्
verses.iast:
etac ca eva ubhayam śrutvā samyak sampaśya rāghava |
uttiṣṭha tvam mahā bāho mām ca spṛśa tathā udakam
verses.translation: "O the mighty armed Bharata! Having listened to their testimony and mine, reflect on the matter carefull. Rise and touch me and drink water."

verses.devanagari:
अथ उत्थाय जलम् स्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
शृण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिणः श्रेणयः तथा
verses.iast:
atha utthāya jalam spṛṣṭvā bharato vākyam abravīt |
śṛṇvantu me pariṣado mantriṇaḥ śreṇayaḥ tathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, Bharata rose, touched water and spoke as follows: "Let the audience, including ministers and the guild of traders hear me also."

verses.devanagari:
न याचे पितरम् राज्यम् न अनुशासामि मातरम् |
आर्यम् परम धर्मज्नम् अभिजानामि राघवम्
verses.iast:
na yāce pitaram rājyam na anuśāsāmi mātaram |
āryam parama dharmajnam abhijānāmi rāghavam
verses.translation: "I never asked my father for the kingdom, nor did I counsel my mother to enthrone me. I never gave my approval for the exile of Rama, the venerable hero, who knows his duty very well."

glosses.meaning: who knows his duty very well.

verses.devanagari:
यदि तु अवश्यम् वस्तव्यम् कर्तव्यम् च पितुर् वचः |
अहम् एव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश वने समाः
verses.iast:
yadi tu avaśyam vastavyam kartavyam ca pitur vacaḥ |
aham eva nivatsyāmi caturdaśa vane samāḥ
verses.translation: "If it is absolutely essential that one of us should remain here and the command of our father be executed, then it is I who will reside in the forest for fourteen years."

glosses.meaning: (that one of us_ should remain here

verses.devanagari:
धर्म आत्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर् वाक्येन विस्मितः |
उवाच रामः सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौर जानपदम् जनम्
verses.iast:
dharma ātmā tasya tathyena bhrātur vākyena vismitaḥ |
uvāca rāmaḥ samprekṣya paura jānapadam janam
verses.translation: The high-souled Rama was surprised by the sincere words of his brother and by looking at the inhabitants of town and country, spoke (as follows):

glosses.meaning: the inhabitants of town and country

verses.devanagari:
विक्रीतम् आहितम् क्रीतम् यत् पित्रा जीवता मम |
न तल् लोपयितुम् शक्यम् मया वा भरतेन वा
verses.iast:
vikrītam āhitam krītam yat pitrā jīvatā mama |
na tal lopayitum śakyam mayā vā bharatena vā
verses.translation: "The disposal, the pledge and the come-by which he was alive, cannot be broken either by me or by Bharata."

verses.devanagari:
उपधिर् न मया कार्यो वन वासे जुगुप्सितः |
युक्तम् उक्तम् च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतम् कृतम्
verses.iast:
upadhir na mayā kāryo vana vāse jugupsitaḥ |
yuktam uktam ca kaikeyyā pitrā me sukṛtam kṛtam
verses.translation: "I cannot accede to the substitute in respect of the sojourn in the forest and it is distasteful thing. What was advised by Kaikeyi was proper and what was done by my father was a righteous deed."

glosses.meaning: in respect of the sojourn in the forest

verses.devanagari:
जानामि भरतम् क्षान्तम् गुरु सत्कार कारिणम् |
सर्वम् एव अत्र कल्याणम् सत्य संधे महात्मनि
verses.iast:
jānāmi bharatam kṣāntam guru satkāra kāriṇam |
sarvam eva atra kalyāṇam satya saṃdhe mahātmani
verses.translation: "I am aware that Bharata has necessary patience and due devotion for the elders. All will be propitious in the case of this magnanimous Bharata, who is true to his promise."

glosses.meaning: in the case of this Bharata
who is true to his promise

verses.devanagari:
अनेन धर्म शीलेन वनात् प्रत्यागतः पुनः |
भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्याः पतिर् उत्तमः
verses.iast:
anena dharma śīlena vanāt pratyāgataḥ punaḥ |
bhrātrā saha bhaviṣyāmi pṛthivyāḥ patir uttamaḥ
verses.translation: "After returning from the forest, I shall rule the earth, assisted by my virtuous brother."

verses.devanagari:
वृतो राजा हि कैकेय्या मया तद् वचनम् कृतम् |
अनृतान् मोचय अनेन पितरम् तम् मही पतिम्
verses.iast:
vṛto rājā hi kaikeyyā mayā tad vacanam kṛtam |
anṛtān mocaya anena pitaram tam mahī patim
verses.translation: "The king Dasaratha was indeed solicited for a boon by Kaikeyi. That word of the king has been fulfilled by me. Hence, relieve our father, the emperor from the blame."
